topic: print double-sided on a printer without automatic duplex
core_question: How do I print on both sides of the paper if my printer can't do it automatically?
answer_summary: Print the odd-numbered pages, then flip the printed stack and reload it in the tray in the correct orientation to print the even-numbered pages on the reverse.
